bestBets.overview: 1800m Maiden Hcp. Note only 14 can run. Map suggests no's 2,3,5,6,8,11,12 could be setting the pace, each do some of the time, just not all of the time. Too soon to know how the track is playing but if they can win from the back it sure set up beautifully for DISGRUNTLED and the price was right. Alas, it's staying home. And the stablemate RAFA would be here with a show as well.  Conversely I SAY I SAY and BILLS ANGEL map well and on latest efforts could be winning. Chances wouldn't end with just them either.

raceTips.comment: BARTLE FREE bounced back from a luckless run to finish second last start at Kilcoy. Strong through the line on that occasion, the rise to 1800m looks ideal. FIVE OF US is hard fit and racing well. The runner up in all three starts over this trip, she looks very well placed but she does have the tricky draw to contend with. I SAY I SAY has been placed in three of his past four starts and closed off strongly last time when stepping out to the mile. LAURIE’S QUILL has filled the minors at his past two runs and looks ideally suited here at 1800m. If he can find cover off the wide gate, he’ll be strong late.

bestBets.overview: 1000m Maiden Plate. No's 3,5,10 could be the pace. As things stand four of the  eleven are returning from a spell. Cardiac arrhythmia was the reason MAGIC INVADER performed so poorly when resuming, has the ability to be too quick for this lot. If on the drift one can only be concerned and I'd advise keeping right out from a financial point of view. The resuming pair DRINKWATER and PIERATA'S SPIRIT have won trials leading in to this. Both were on this track (over different distances). The resuming PIETARI placed 2nd in a recent trial at Beaudesert.

raceTips.comment: PIERATA’S SPIRIT resumes. He was well supported on debut at Eagle Farm but felt the pinch late and was subsequently spelled. He looked sharp winning a recent Gold Coast trial and gets Ryan Maloney to steer from a good gate. MAGIC INVADER has been placed on six occasions and is certainly capable. He pulled up with cardiac arrythmia after failing to figure first up and can bounce back here. DRINKWATER has shown talent at the trials but has failed in figure in three race starts. Given time, he looks to have returned in good order and the 1000m kick off will suit. PIETARI resumes off a lengthy break. He’s trialled up well and gets in nicely with the 3kg claim.

bestBets.overview: 1000m QTIS 3yo Maiden Hcp. A dozen can run and a dozen will. Four of the dozen will be on debut, five resume. Suffice to say not a race one can assess with much confidence at all, who is fit and prepped to win, who will be wiser for the experience. Market may assist at some stage. Having said that, BRAVE ETOILE 'should' be hard to beat. A close 3rd on debut to the smart Cherry Bomshell augurs well for a maiden anywhere, not just in Queensland. Had no favours next start in The Jewel and went for a spell. The resuming SWEET REBELLION has been all the rage in early betting. In these circumstances if any emergency which appeared to be lucky to get a start, does get in, and if backed, do not argue.

raceTips.comment: BRAVE ETOILE returns. She was terrific on debut in the Aquis Jewel Prelude, charging home to claim third but didn’t have much luck from a wide gate in the Jewel. She was good through the line in a recent trial and the blinkers go on. STEVIE’S SPIRIT makes her debut. She looks ready to go off two Doomben trial wins, where she’s done it easily on each occasion. The wide draw is a worry but if she can find a spot without doing too much work early, she’ll take beating. SWEET REBELLION kicks off her campaign. She’s been placed in both runs to date and looks ready to go off two recent trials. She draws well and Bella Youngberry will take 1.5kgs off. XPLAIN THIS showed plenty of natural speed on debut at Gatton but was just claimed late. She strips fitter and back to the 1000m from the low draw, she’ll be in it for a long way.

bestBets.overview: 1400m Open Hcp. No's 5,6,7,9,10 bring good pace to the race. Sets up beautifully for the track specialist, LADY SHOTGUN. Fitter for two from a spell, placing in both. Drops a stack in weight from both as well. Likely to miss the start a length or so, don't panic, it's what this Lady does.  Sets up well for DEEP RESPECT, wasn't far off in the Casino Cup last start. ARCHER'S GAME put its turn of hoof to good use winning the Noosa Cup fresh, albeit that race was hammered by half the field including both fav's scratching. Wary of the stablemate, the resuming THINKHARDANDFAST, market should be a very good guide.

raceTips.comment: LADY SHOTGUN strips fitter for the two runs back and looks ready to peak. She hasn’t won for some time but she’s tackled stronger coming during her past couple of campaigns and this race should set up nicely for her. ARCHER’S GAME proved too good when resuming over 1400m at the Sunshine Coast. She holds a strong second up record and gets in beautifully with the claim. THINKHARDANDFAST resumes. She races well fresh and the 1400m kick off will suit. Given three trials in preparation for his return, she looks ready to go. DEEP RESPECT got a long way back and closed off strongly last start in the Casino Cup. He’ll appreciate getting back on a bigger track and can figure in this.

raceTips.comment: MAQUISA resumes and does race very well fresh. She boasts solid form around her and the 1200m kick off will suit. She caught the eye in a recent Gold Coast trial and looks ready to fire. BEREZKA has performed well in both runs back this time in and should find this easier than what she’s been contesting. At peak fitness, the winkers go on and she’ll be strong late. STRADA VARENNA got back and was always wide when resuming for the new stable. She will have taken improvement from the run and the low draw can see her settle within striking range. OUR HUNTRESS comes off five week freshen up as she looks to make it three straight wins. A very honest mare, she gets in well with the claim and will be right there at the finish.

raceTips.comment: AUTUMN GIRL just had one get the better of her late last time in Class 3 company at Doomben. Back in grade, the 1400m here looks ideal and she gets in nicely with the claim. She just has to overcome the wide gate. MYTHOLOGY comes off a solid first up effort over 1200m at Doomben. She strips fitter, the rise to 1400m suit and the blinkers go back on. CANTARITO got back and finished off strongly into second when resuming over 1400m at the Sunshine Coast. She has won second up previously and will be doing her best work late. DIVINE JUSTICE comes out of that same race, where she just looked to peak on her run late. She strips fitter and draws to get the right run.
